rationale: VERSION 1.3.0 -> 3.0.0 and pinned the canonical rule at db42b0b2c380.; Replaced nine coupled, dead, contradictory, or invalid controls with one exact scene_profile axis observable from every returned grid.; Added a 4/13 default prior over all four complete published input geometries under color permutation and D4 symmetry; no published output is stored.; Added connected fuzzy horizontal and vertical partitions for exactly three, four, and five-or-six colors.; Added explicit two-color equality, row-margin-one, and column-margin-one profiles to teach the >= orientation boundary rather than a band-direction shortcut.; Added a complete semantic analyzer, strong self_check, override observer, independent Python rule mirror, deterministic fresh returns, and focused regression tests.; Synchronized the base executable Racket sources to the canonical authority.
summary: Scan nonzero cells in row-major order and record each color at its first appearance. Compare the row and column spans of those first cells: if row_span is greater than or equal to col_span, emit the colors in order as a column; otherwise emit them as a row.
